correctness.rationale: Independence permits at most one hub color and only opposite-side leaves in its presence, giving A=A_U*A_V, B=F_u*A_V, C=F_v*A_U with the two leaf joins as intersections. Each attaching inclusion is nullhomotopic by coning with a vertex, so the two homotopy pushouts add the suspensions of A_U and A_V. The join of the indicated discrete spaces is a wedge with multiplicity the product of the reduced zero-homology ranks; this gives PQ, k_v P, k_u Q in the claimed degrees. For the action, inclusion of A gives the canonical top homology isomorphism because the relative complex has dimension at most max(p,q)<p+q-1; in the lower degrees the map to relative homology is an isomorphism since both adjacent homologies of A vanish there. The two relative chain summands have differential minus the augmented opposite-leaf differential with hub-first orientation, so the unmodified whole hub permutation lattice appears. This convention gives no extra lower-degree sign under pure side exchange, while exchanging ordered leaf blocks in the top exterior orientation gives (-1)^(pq). Independent leaf-fiber color groups have no rational invariants in their augmentation lattices. On barycentric subdivision there are no inversions; rational orbit chains are coinvariants and averaging is exact, so the connected orbit space is rationally acyclic. Hub-invariant elements have augmentation divisible by the hub size, proving integral nonsplitting. Inspected both bundled scripts and CHECKS.txt without executing the source; modular Betti ranks and signed Lefschetz traces are corroboration, not the integral-module proof.
